description:
Use this when you need a state/territory-specific Australian date offset in 2026-2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the division is unknown or the task needs local, employer, exchange or future-year rules.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts working days using the selected Australian state/territory public-holiday calendar.
Example user requests: Add five NSW working days after 2026-04-24.
Inputs: start_date (date); division (enum); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-04-24","division":"nsw","working_days":5}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, division, division_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_observed, limited_or_part_day_events, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, regional_policy, dataset_version.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when selected status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/australia-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/australia-add-working-days.md

division.description: Required Australian state/territory code: act, nsw, nt, qld, sa, tas, vic or wa.

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_australia_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: State/territory-wide full-day public holidays plus weekly baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or public holiday.

holiday_names.description: Full-day public holidays applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when an additional/substitute date is explicitly listed.

is_working_day.description: True when the date is not a weekend or included full-day state/territory public holiday.

limited_or_part_day_events.description: Regional, partial-day, public-service-only or otherwise limited events that do not close the full division by default.

source_quality.description: Official government sources with state/territory scope.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Australia State/Territory Working Days
